answer: Escrowed deposits and a referral reef stop fake identities. Each agent posts 100 POA, locked 20 epochs on a quartz clock. Its referrer is public, so clones that wander in from one sponsor form a star cluster. A peer dispute stakes 10 POA per side; the loser is slashed and the referrer shares the penalty. Forging 100 identities costs 10,000 POA plus the referrer's stake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
